scope: Compiled definitions snapshot; actual bridge exercised by runtime-rc3.json
researchPrompt: For a difficult or uncertain challenge, use ctf_teams_hypothesis for competing explanations, then ctf_teams_experiment(action="plan") before expensive exploitation or brute force. State a reproducible method, a positive observable, a falsifying observable, a stable coverage_key for the same input/target/parameters, estimated cost and a bounded run/time budget. Include a cheap control that can disprove the shared premise; a 500, timeout or failed tool is not scientific refutation. action="next" gives a transparent cost-first shortlist, not a probability of success. Test distinct hypotheses instead of assigning several agents the same premise. Use the returned experiment_ref in ctf_teams_exec. Once focused, omitting/changing the reference cannot bypass that owner's review boundary. Docker admission limits runs and caps each command to the remaining experiment time. Read jobs/logs and report observation, validity and evidence. The captain reviews named test IDs and reasons, not a vote count. Reviewed refutation and repeated valid inconclusive tests require review before further experiments. Only the captain may release/reopen a route with a reason; reopen preserves history and cannot erase a refutation. Team pause freezes the clock and preserves plans, without granting old task attempts new authority. Native shells and other tools are not governed by Docker experiment budgets.
memberPrompt: You are a CTFTeams expert. Follow your task/persona and current attempt_id. Use ctf_teams_hypothesis/experiment for competing explanations, cheap falsifying controls and bounded Docker experiments; inspect logs and report validity. Stop at review/budget boundaries; ask captain to change/reopen the route. Share findings and send one task-scoped report to captain. Never create, approve, edit or resume teams, verify flags, erase failed work or relabel stale attempts. If durable membership is missing, report to parent; never create a replacement.

experimentTool.description: Choose and bound difficult-challenge experiments. next/list are read-only. plan records distinct positive/falsifying observables, coverage key and cost; it never executes. Use experiment_ref in ctf_teams_exec for Docker run/time stop-loss. report links finished jobs to unverified hypothesis evidence. Only captain reviews named tests or releases/reopens a route with a reason. stop cancels owned jobs and retains work. No timers/model wakeups or automatic solve verdicts. Old unplanned commands retain compatibility; once focused, an owner cannot omit/change the reference to evade review.

ledger_ref.description: All mutations: exact current ledger_ref. Read next/list first.

experiment_ref.description: Exact generation-bound reference from plan/list; report/stop/release/reopen.

hypothesis_id.description: plan/review: existing hypothesis in the same team.

alternatives.description: plan: up to 5 other hypotheses distinguished by this test; same challenge.

coverage_key.description: plan: stable input/target/parameter identity, 1..160 chars. Cross-member duplicate work returns the original plan.

method.description: plan: reproducible test method, at most 2000 chars. Data only.

if_true.description: plan: expected observable if the main hypothesis holds.

if_false.description: plan: observable that would falsify the main hypothesis.

estimated_seconds.description: plan: estimated cost, 1..3600, not a success probability.

budget_seconds.description: plan: active wall-time budget from first launch, default 300; 1..3600. Team halt freezes it.

max_runs.description: plan: max Docker commands this cycle, default 3, max 20.

bind_task_id.description: captain reopen: explicit current task binding after pause/reassignment.

owner.description: captain reopen: explicitly transfer to this current task owner; history remains.

expected_revision.description: stop/release/reopen: current experiment revision. review/report: current hypothesis revision.

observation.description: report: actual observation, at most 4000 chars.

validity.description: report: non-valid tests must be inconclusive.

test_ids.description: review: 1..20 hypothesis test IDs inspected by captain.

reason.description: review/stop/release/reopen: concrete justification, at most 2000 chars.

guards: Captain review/release/reopen and current task/attempt checked at the execution boundary.
